ai.title: Remove packageManager field from package.json
ai.summary: Deleted the `packageManager` field specifying `bun@1.1.27` from `package.json`. This field caused confusion for `manicode`. Scope limited to root `package.json`.

eli5.text: The project dropped a line from its configuration file that told the assistant to use a specific tool runner. That line was causing confusion for one of the internal tools, so the team removed it from the main configuration file only. If you looked at the configuration file today, you would no longer see that line specifying the tool runner. This only affects the main project configuration, so other files and setups are unchanged.

ai.title: Drop anthropic key rotation
ai.summary: backend/src/claude.ts stops randomizing between ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY2. Directly assigns ANTHROPIC_API_KEY2. Reason: upstream rate limit increase. Scope: backend claude.ts only.

eli5.text: The system used to pick between two login keys each time you sent a question to Claude, randomly bouncing between them to handle traffic. Now it always uses the second key, because the provider raised how many requests that key can handle per minute. If you looked at the system settings you'd see one key slot instead of two being filled.

ai.title: Exclude tool results from User Input logs
ai.summary: websocket-action.ts now skips logging lastMessage.content when TOOL_RESULT_MARKER is present. Prevents raw tool execution output from flooding application logs. Applies to backend WebSocket user input handling.

eli5.text: When the system records what you send over a live backend connection, it used to also capture the raw output that came back from running internal tools, which cluttered the logs. That output is now left out, so your submitted messages are recorded without the tool execution noise mixed in. This only affects how the backend logs your input, so if you ever inspect those logs, they will show just your message instead of your message plus tool results.
